name: Susdera
backstory: Susdera is a necromancer of the Cult of Myrkul. She is found atop Moonrise Towers, and assists Ketheric Thorm in battle against the party.
voice_hint: human wizard (voiced by Lucy Paterson, Luisa Guerreiro)
